item.tib: khro bo spyi 'dul las kyi kha tshar sbyin sreg me dpung dgu sgril
item.coloph: spyi 'dul yongs rdzogs las/ sbyin bsregs (sreg) me dpung dgu sgril 'di/ bka' bab dge bshes nang so g.yung drung bstan 'dzin gyis/ shing glang zla ba gsum pa'i dkar phyogs su bkra shis dben pa'i khrod du sbyar ba'o//
